english.title: Fail to comply with direction to move a vehicle so that immobilisation device may be fitted
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[to move]_
(B)_[direct the moving of]_

a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), for the purpose of enabling an immobilisation device to be fitted to it
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 5 of the Road Safety (Immobilisation, Removal and Disposal of Vehicles) Regulations 2009.

english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, failed to comply within a reasonable time with a direction under regulation 4(1)(b) of the Road Safety (Immobilisation, Removal and Disposal of Vehicles) Regulations 2009, issued by an authorised person or a person acting under the direction of an authorised person to

(A)_[move]_

a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), for the purpose of enabling an immobilisation device to be fitted to it.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
